points.title: 音乐启蒙
points.description: 普契尼出生于意大利托斯卡纳地区的卢卡市，出身于一个音乐世家。他的父亲米歇尔是卢卡教堂的管风琴师和音乐指导，在普契尼五岁时去世。家族期望普契尼成为管风琴师，但他对歌剧更感兴趣。在卢卡音乐学院学习期间，他受到当地音乐传统的影响，特别是教堂音乐和民间音乐的熏陶。1876年，他观看了威尔第的《阿依达》后深受震撼，决心投身歌剧创作。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Lucca, Tuscany, Puccini came from a musical family. His father, Michele, was the maestro di cappella and organist at Lucca Cathedral, who died when Puccini was five. The family expected him to follow in his father's footsteps as an organist, but he was more drawn to opera. During his studies at the Lucca Music Institute, he was influenced by local musical traditions, particularly church music and folk melodies. In 1876, after seeing Verdi's 'Aida', he was profoundly inspired and determined to dedicate himself to opera composition.

points.title: 音乐学院深造
points.description: 1880年，普契尼获得奖学金进入米兰音乐学院，师从著名作曲家蓬基耶利和巴齐尼。在米兰的三年学习期间，他接受了系统的音乐理论训练，同时深入研究了威尔第等大师的作品。1883年，他的毕业作品《群妖围舞》获得成功，这为他赢得了首次歌剧创作的机会。米兰时期是普契尼艺术风格形成的关键阶段，他开始融合意大利传统与新兴的瓦格纳式音乐元素，形成了自己独特的音乐语言。
points.descriptionEn: In 1880, Puccini entered the Milan Conservatory on a scholarship, studying under renowned composers Ponchielli and Bazzini. During his three years in Milan, he received systematic musical training and studied the works of masters like Verdi. His graduation piece, 'Capriccio sinfonico' (1883), was successful, earning him his first opportunity for opera composition. This Milan period was crucial in forming Puccini's artistic style, as he began to blend Italian traditions with emerging Wagnerian elements, creating his unique musical language.

points.title: 成名之作
points.description: 1893年，普契尼的第三部歌剧《曼侬·莱斯科》在都灵首演，获得巨大成功。这部作品改编自法国作家普雷沃的小说，讲述了一位美丽但轻浮的女子曼侬的故事。普契尼在这部作品中展现了他对女性心理的深刻理解和细腻的音乐表现力。首演当晚，作曲家马斯卡尼和观众都为之倾倒，确立了普契尼在意大利歌剧界的地位。这部作品的成功使普契尼获得了创作下一部歌剧《波西米亚人》的委托，这部作品后来成为他最著名的代表作之一。
points.descriptionEn: In 1893, Puccini's third opera, 'Manon Lescaut', premiered in Turin to great success. Adapted from French author Prevost's novel, it tells the story of a beautiful but fickle woman, Manon. In this work, Puccini demonstrated his deep understanding of female psychology and delicate musical expression. On the premiere night, composer Mascagni and the audience were captivated, establishing Puccini's position in the Italian opera world. This success earned him the commission for his next opera, 'La Bohème', which later became one of his most famous works.

points.title: 巅峰创作
points.description: 1896年，普契尼在米兰创作并首演了他的杰作《波西米亚人》，这部作品改编自法国作家亨利·穆热的小说，讲述了巴黎拉丁区一群艺术家的生活与爱情。1900年，他的另一部重要作品《托斯卡》在罗马首演，这部政治惊悚剧展现了普契尼对戏剧冲突的把握能力。1904年，《蝴蝶夫人》在米兰首演，虽然初演失败，但经过修改后成为经典。这一时期是普契尼创作生涯的黄金阶段，他创作了三部最著名的作品，确立了他在意大利歌剧界的领导地位。
points.descriptionEn: In 1896, Puccini created and premiered his masterpiece 'La Bohème' in Milan, adapted from French author Henri Murger's novel about the lives and loves of artists in Paris's Latin Quarter. In 1900, his other major work, 'Tosca', premiered in Rome, a political thriller that showcased Puccini's mastery of dramatic conflict. In 1904, 'Madama Butterfly' premiered in Milan; although initially unsuccessful, it became a classic after revisions. This period was the golden age of Puccini's career, during which he created his three most famous works, establishing his leadership in Italian opera.

points.title: 隐居创作
points.description: 1904年，普契尼在托斯卡纳的托雷德尔拉戈购置了一座别墅，并在此度过了他生命中最后的二十年。这里靠近他喜爱的湖泊，为他提供了宁静的创作环境。在此期间，他创作了《西部女郎》(1910)、《燕子》(1917)和《贾尼·斯基基》(1918)等重要作品。1909年，普契尼卷入一场丑闻，他的妻子埃尔维拉指控他与女仆有染，导致女仆自杀，这一事件对普契尼的声誉造成了一定影响。第一次世界大战期间，普契尼的创作活动有所减少，但他仍然坚持创作，并开始对新兴的爵士音乐产生兴趣。
points.descriptionEn: In 1904, Puccini purchased a villa in Torre del Lago, Tuscany, where he spent the last twenty years of his life. Near his beloved lake, it provided a tranquil environment for composition. During this period, he created important works such as 'La Fanciulla del West' (1910), 'La Rondine' (1917), and 'Gianni Schicchi' (1918). In 1909, Puccini was embroiled in a scandal when his wife, Elvira, accused him of having an affair with their maid, who subsequently committed suicide, damaging his reputation. During World War I, his creative activities decreased, but he continued to compose and began to develop an interest in the emerging jazz music.

points.title: 最后岁月
points.description: 1921年后，普契尼的健康状况开始恶化，他被诊断出患有喉癌。尽管如此，他仍然坚持创作，完成了《图兰朵》的大部分创作，这部作品后来由他的学生阿尔法诺根据他的草稿完成。1924年11月，普契尼前往布鲁塞尔接受放射治疗，但治疗无效，于11月29日在布鲁塞尔去世。他的葬礼在米兰举行，遗体后被运回卢卡安葬。普契尼去世时，《图兰朵》尚未完成，这部作品成为他最著名的遗作，其中的咏叹调'今夜无人入睡'成为世界闻名的歌剧选段。
points.descriptionEn: After 1921, Puccini's health began to deteriorate; he was diagnosed with throat cancer. Despite this, he continued to compose, completing most of 'Turandot', which was later finished by his student Alfano based on his sketches. In November 1924, Puccini traveled to Brussels for radiation therapy, but it was ineffective, and he died there on November 29. His funeral was held in Milan, and his remains were later returned to Lucca for burial. At his death, 'Turandot' was unfinished, yet it became his most famous posthumous work, with the aria 'Nessun dorma' achieving worldwide fame.

appraisal.zh: 普契尼通常被视为意大利歌剧传统的集大成者，他延续威尔第的道路，以优美旋律、细腻情感和对女性心理的刻画著称，并把意大利传统与瓦格纳式和声熔于一炉，《波西米亚人》《托斯卡》《蝴蝶夫人》至今是世界歌剧舞台的常演剧目；他也是真实主义歌剧的代表人物，其音乐更超出歌剧界成为全球文化符号。不过也有研究者指出，他有时过于迎合观众口味，旋律虽美而深度与复杂性不足，戏剧结构偶显牵强，作品亦少涉重大社会议题。
appraisal.en: Puccini is generally seen as the culmination of the Italian operatic tradition, extending Verdi's path with memorable melody, delicate feeling and acute portrayal of female psychology, fusing Italian tradition with Wagnerian harmony; La Bohème, Tosca and Madama Butterfly remain staples of the world stage, and as a leading verismo composer he became a global cultural symbol. Yet some researchers note that he could cater to audience taste, that his melody sometimes lacks depth and complexity, that his plots can feel contrived, and that his works rarely address major social questions.

supporter.zh: 普契尼被赞誉为意大利歌剧的集大成者，他继承了威尔第的传统并将其推向新的高度。他的作品以其优美的旋律、细腻的情感表达和对女性心理的深刻洞察而著称。普契尼的音乐融合了意大利传统与瓦格纳式的和声，创造出独特的音乐语言。他的歌剧如《波西米亚人》、《托斯卡》和《蝴蝶夫人》已成为世界歌剧舞台上的经典，影响了后世无数作曲家。普契尼的作品不仅具有艺术价值，还展现了普通人的情感与生活，使歌剧这一艺术形式更加贴近大众。
supporter.en: Puccini is celebrated as the culmination of Italian opera, carrying on Verdi's tradition while elevating it to new heights. His works are renowned for their beautiful melodies, delicate emotional expression, and profound insight into female psychology. Puccini's music blended Italian traditions with Wagnerian harmonies, creating a unique musical language. His operas such as 'La Bohème', 'Tosca', and 'Madama Butterfly' have become classics on the world opera stage, influencing countless composers. His works not only possess artistic value but also depict the emotions and lives of ordinary people, making opera more accessible to the general public.

critic.zh: 批评者指出普契尼的歌剧存在商业化倾向，过于迎合观众口味而缺乏艺术创新。他的音乐被批评为过于依赖优美旋律而缺乏深度和复杂性。一些评论家认为普契尼的作品在戏剧结构上存在缺陷，情节发展有时显得牵强。此外，普契尼的个人生活也备受争议，包括他与女仆的丑闻以及对待女性的态度问题。在政治立场上，普契尼被批评为缺乏社会责任感，他的作品很少涉及重大社会问题，更多关注个人情感和浪漫故事。
critic.en: Critics point out that Puccini's operas have commercial tendencies, catering too much to audience tastes at the expense of artistic innovation. His music has been criticized for relying excessively on beautiful melodies without sufficient depth and complexity. Some commentators argue that Puccini's works have structural flaws, with plot developments sometimes appearing contrived. Additionally, Puccini's personal life was controversial, including his scandal with the maid and his attitudes toward women. Politically, he was criticized for lacking social responsibility, as his works rarely addressed major social issues, focusing instead on personal emotions and romantic stories.

objective.zh: 从历史与流行文化视角看，普契尼是意大利歌剧黄金时代的最后一位大师，他的作品连接了19世纪和20世纪的歌剧传统。在音乐史上，普契尼被视为真实主义歌剧的代表人物，他的作品反映了当时社会变革和艺术思潮的变化。在流行文化中，普契尼的音乐超越了歌剧界，成为全球性的文化符号，尤其是《图兰朵》中的'今夜无人入睡'已成为世界闻名的文化元素。普契尼的作品持续影响着现代音乐创作，他的歌剧不断在世界各大歌剧院上演，证明了其持久的艺术魅力和文化影响力。
objective.en: From a historical and popular culture perspective, Puccini represents the last master of Italian opera's golden age, bridging the traditions of the 19th and 20th centuries. In music history, he is regarded as a key figure in verismo opera, with his works reflecting the social changes and artistic movements of his time. In popular culture, Puccini's music has transcended the opera world to become a global cultural symbol, particularly 'Nessun dorma' from 'Turandot', which has achieved worldwide fame. His works continue to influence modern music composition, and his operas are constantly performed in major opera houses worldwide, demonstrating their enduring artistic charm and cultural impact.

self.zh: 歌剧就是歌剧，不是文学，不是哲学，不是政治，而是音乐。
self.en: Opera is opera, not literature, not philosophy, not politics, but music.
